title: coleus penicillatus
intro: Coleus penicillatus, commonly known as Coleus, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Coleus penicillatus include the treatment of fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Coleus penicillatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
